description: This file defines the registry for invoke and capability commands in the OpenClaw Android application, including data classes for node flags and capabilities, enum classes for command and capability availability, and a singleton object 'InvokeCommandRegistry' that lists available commands and capabilities based on node runtime flags.

classes.name: NodeRuntimeFlags
classes.description: Encapsulates boolean flags indicating the enabled features and capabilities of the node, such as camera, location, SMS, call log, voice wake, motion, and build type.

classes.name: InvokeCommandAvailability
classes.description: Enum representing the availability prerequisites or conditions for invoke commands, such as always available or dependent on specific node features.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityAvailability
classes.description: Enum defining the availability conditions for node capabilities, indicating if they are always available or contingent upon specific features like camera or motion.

classes.name: NodeCapabilitySpec
classes.description: Data class representing a node's capability with its name and availability condition.

classes.name: InvokeCommandSpec
classes.description: Data class representing an invoke command, its name, whether it requires foreground execution, and its availability based on node features.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Retrieves an InvokeCommandSpec by command name.

methods.name: advertisedCapabilities
methods.description: Returns a list of capability names that are advertised/available given particular node runtime flags.

methods.name: advertisedCommands
methods.description: Returns a list of command names that are available given particular node runtime flags.
